reason: I can afford it, but nothing here tells me what the filter actually removes. On top of that, the only way to avoid $13 shipping is to sign up for another subscription, and I stopped doing that after getting burned.
objection: How do I know the filter actually does anything? 'Rated up to 150 L' by the supplier isn't independent lab testing or a certification, and a creator code doesn't make me trust it more.
would_change_my_mind: Independent test results or a certification showing what the filter removes, plus free shipping on the bottle alone without a subscription.
